svg.title: Ensa database schema
svg.text: 188 tables · 2565 columns · 275 relationships · 7 011 267 rows · schema ensa of EnsaDbDEv
foreign key, drawn as an edge

Audit columns (creation, modification, soft delete) are summarised in each footer. TenantId and CompanyId are shown as badges instead of edges: 123 and 37 lines into a single box would hide the schema rather than show it.
